cases.intent: I have a big feature that needs research, design, coding and review by different people — own the whole thing and report back.
cases.notes: Multi-agent, multi-lane task; CHEF owns the outcome (Use when: task spans research, creative design, programming, automation, or multiple agents).

cases.intent: Coordinate three agents to rebuild the landing page, verify each other's work, and hand me a verified result.
cases.notes: Cross-agent coordination with independent verification; CHEF is the accountable orchestrator.

cases.intent: This task spans research, coding and automation; just get it done rather than teaching me the implementation.
cases.notes: User asks CHEF to own the outcome rather than teach implementation.

cases.intent: The login button broke after the last deploy — reproduce it, fix it, and prove the fix works.
cases.notes: Defect report; reproduce -> patch -> replay the same user scenario (When to use: user reports a defect).

cases.intent: CI is failing on main; find the cause, repair it, and verify the repair before handoff.
cases.notes: CI failure; the outcome must be independently verified before handoff.

cases.intent: I need this code change verified against the same user scenario before I accept it.
cases.notes: Change whose outcome must be independently verified; not permission to modify production.

cases.intent: Map the checkout flow from landing to confirmation, including what happens when payment fails.
cases.notes: User-facing path with failure edges; produce replayable test scenarios.

cases.intent: Tests pass but I'm not sure the signup journey actually works for a real user — check the visible journey.
cases.notes: Test passes without proving the visible journey (When to use).

cases.intent: Write replayable test scenarios for the new settings page before we ship it.
cases.notes: Feature whose real user behavior is ambiguous; map entry, actions, results and failure edges.

cases.intent: I wrote a new skill from a workflow that worked — review it with the rubric before I install it.
cases.notes: New skill written from successful task experience; candidate acceptance before installation.

cases.intent: This installed skill started behaving differently after the update — evaluate whether it is still safe to keep.
cases.notes: Installed skill shows a regression / environment drift.

cases.intent: Should I install this candidate skill? Run the acceptance gates first.
cases.notes: Candidate Skill acceptance: scenario rubric, independent evidence review, explicit autonomy gates.

cases.intent: Design a poster for the new collection — editorial style, giant type.
Redesign this landing page's visual direction and review the typography and layout quality.
Analyse the style of this reference image and extract the design DNA for our brand.
I have a vague idea for an app but I don't know what I want yet — ask me questions until it's clear.
cases.notes: Ask is underspecified; interview one question at a time until about 95% confidence.

cases.intent: Grill me about the requirements before we write any code.
cases.notes: User says 'grill me' — interview-me trigger phrase (description: Use when the user says 'interview me' or 'grill me').

cases.intent: My request is underspecified and the requirements must be pinned down before any implementation.
cases.notes: Requirements unclear; must be pinned down before implementation.

description: Intent -> expected-skill routing cases for aka-cristi-skills. Each case is a user phrasing; the eval asserts chef-orchestrator names the expected skill (see evals/run_evals.py for the parse basis). Coverage: 3 cases per skill, 6 skills, 18 cases total.
